description.fi: Alennus koskee Advanced-vuositilausta ja on tarkoitettu opiskelijoille, joilla ei vielä ole maksullista Evernote-tilausta.
description.en: The discount applies to the Advanced annual plan and is meant for students who do not already have a paid Evernote subscription.

eligibility.fi: Opiskelijat, joilla ei ole voimassa olevaa maksullista Evernote-tilausta.
eligibility.en: Students who are not currently subscribed to a paid Evernote plan.

steps.en: Verify your student status with UNiDAYS.
